commands:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'Checking network access and available download paths...\n'
for cmd in yt-dlp youtube-dl ffmpeg ffprobe; do command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$cmd:yes" || echo "$cmd:no"; done
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
url='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCbvyPbhRfA'
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=15) as r:
        print('HTTP', r.status)
        print(r.read(200).decode('utf-8','ignore'))
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', type(e).__name__, e)
PY
